ideas.title: Mechanics: motion, forces and momentum
ideas.mechanism: Net force changes momentum; kinematics describes the resulting motion.

ideas.title: Energy, work and power
ideas.mechanism: Work transfers energy; power is the rate. Mechanical energy redistributes under constraints.

ideas.title: Oscillations, waves and optics
ideas.mechanism: A disturbance propagates by oscillation of a medium or field; optics is wave/ray behaviour of light.

ideas.title: Electric circuits and current electricity
ideas.mechanism: Charge flow in a closed path; potential difference drives current against resistance.

ideas.title: Fields: gravitational, electric, magnetic
ideas.mechanism: A source produces a field that exerts a force on a test mass, charge, or current.

ideas.title: Thermal physics and matter
ideas.mechanism: Temperature tracks microscopic kinetic energy; heat is energy transfer; gases link p, V, T, n.

ideas.title: Atomic, nuclear and particle physics
ideas.mechanism: Nuclei and hadrons are structured; radioactive decay and quark composition change identity and radiation.

ideas.title: Quantum and wave-particle physics
ideas.mechanism: Light and matter exchange energy in quanta; photoelectric and spectra need photons, not classical waves alone.

ideas.title: Physical quantities, units and vectors
ideas.mechanism: Every quantity is magnitude (and direction if a vector) with a unit; scalars and vectors combine differently.

ideas.title: Momentum and impulse
ideas.mechanism: Impulse is change of momentum; isolated systems conserve total momentum.

ideas.title: Simple harmonic motion and oscillations
ideas.mechanism: Restoring force proportional to displacement yields periodic SHM; energy sloshes between kinetic and potential.

ideas.title: Superposition: interference, diffraction, stationary waves
ideas.mechanism: Overlapping waves add; path difference and gap size set interference and diffraction patterns.

ideas.title: Circuit laws and practical circuits
ideas.mechanism: Kirchhoff current and loop rules plus series/parallel combination determine currents and p.d.s.

ideas.title: Electromagnetic induction and alternating current
ideas.mechanism: Changing flux induces emf; transformers and a.c. follow from Faraday/Lenz.

ideas.title: Astrophysics and cosmology
ideas.mechanism: Astronomical observations (redshift, standard candles, Hubble) constrain cosmic scale and evolution.

ideas.title: Medical and imaging physics
ideas.mechanism: Ionising and non-ionising probes form diagnostic images; dose and interaction with tissue set the use.

ideas.title: Materials, fluids and deformation
ideas.mechanism: Stress–strain and hydrostatic pressure describe how solids and fluids respond beside the particle-mechanics spine.

ideas.title: Electronics and semiconductor devices
ideas.mechanism: Non-ohmic semiconductor I–V behaviour (diode, LDR, thermistor) is a component class beside metallic circuits.

ideas.title: Practical measurement and data
ideas.mechanism: Instrument choice, uncertainty and graph-from-data are experimental skills beside the content spine (chem B2/B4 analogue).
